resources.name: Elastic constants and structural parameters for KCl, NaCl, CaF2, FeS2

access.notes: CSV file containing substance name, lattice constant a (Å), mass density rho (g/cm³), number of particles per unit cell s, and elastic stiffness constants c11 and c44 (dyn/cm²). The file is included in the task environment at /app/resources/elastic_constants.csv.
